risks.title: Dependence on Canadian government R&D funding
risks.score_rationale: Business-specific risk explicitly mentioned (dedicated paragraph). Moderate language but direct impact on R&D capacity. Stable trend but structural. High weight: R&D is core to UAV technology.

risks.title: Transport Canada regulatory approvals and SFOC certificates
risks.score_rationale: Critical risk mentioned 3 times with strong language (may prevent, no assurance). Central position in Item 1A. RPAS regulation evolving constantly. Maximum weight: operations fully dependent on valid SFOCs.

risks.title: Public privacy concerns and usage restrictions
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned twice with cautious language (no assurance, may delay or restrict). Direct impact on non-military commercial market. Upward trend: growing concerns. High weight for commercial segment.

risks.title: Intensifying UAV competition and technological obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Major business risk with detailed paragraphs. Strong language (intensify, render obsolete). UAV market evolving rapidly. High weight: direct competition on price, quality and product innovation.

risks.title: Commercial UAV market in early adoption phase
risks.score_rationale: UAV sector-specific business risk. Moderate language but structural impact (early stages, difficult to evaluate). Stable but persistent trend. High weight: uncertainty on customer demand and growth.

risks.title: Key personnel and management retention in R&D
risks.score_rationale: Business-specific risk mentioned with moderate language (may not be able to replace). Context: competitive talent market. Stable trend. Medium weight: dependence on drone technical expertise.

risks.title: Operational risks and inadequate insurance coverage
risks.score_rationale: RPAS operations-specific business risk. Moderate language (may not be adequately insured). Enumeration of risks (accidents, incidents). Stable trend. Medium weight: potential impact on liability.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and due diligence risks
risks.score_rationale: Business risk tied to growth-by-acquisition strategy. Moderate language enumerating specific risks (integration, hidden liabilities). Stable trend. Medium weight: acquisitions are part of strategy but not guaranteed.

ai_positioning.summary: Draganfly integrates AI as a component of its autonomous, secure drone solutions, notably for real-time analysis and tactical operations, but does not position AI as the primary driver of growth.
